facts.business: Rexnord Electronics and Controls Limited manufactures instrument cooling fans, shaded pole motors, and components for refrigeration, HVAC, ventilation, and air-movement applications.

capacity_or_capex.item: Automatic robotic assembly lines and automated testing equipment

key_risks: Volatility in prices and availability of key inputs including copper, steel and other engineering materials
Customer concentration and OEM demand cycles
Technological obsolescence and need to keep pace with technological developments
Supply chain disruptions and need for supplier diversification
facts.related_party_note: Includes transactions with subsidiary (loan interest income of Rs 2.87 lakhs in FY2025-26 and Rs 3.68 lakhs in FY2024-25), rental income, and remuneration to key managerial personnel including Mr. Kishorechand Talwar, Mr. Kundan Talwar, Mrs. Nainy Tanna, Mrs. Shweta Kalantri, Mr. Anand Patkar, and Mrs. Ramandeep Talwar.
